# Digitize DFW

Digitize DFW is a solo photo and video digitizing, restoration, and enhancement business serving Flower Mound and the Dallas/Fort Worth, Texas area. Owner David Ferring handles every project personally — pickup, digitizing, and delivery. Originals are never shipped away or outsourced. Customers can drop off and pick up at our Flower Mound location inside the GEICO office at 4630 Long Prairie Rd Ste 200, or David comes to them.

- Website: https://digitizedfw.com
- Phone/Text: 972-584-7622
- Email: david@digitizedfw.com
- Service area: Addison, Allen, Anna, Argyle, Balch Springs, Bedford, Celina, Colleyville, Coppell, Copper Canyon, Dallas, Denton, Double Oak, Euless, Fairview, Farmers Branch, Farmersville, Flower Mound, Fort Worth, Frisco, Glenn Heights, Grapevine, Haltom City, Haslet, Highland Park, Highland Village, Hurst, Irving, Keller, Lantana, Lewisville, Little Elm, Lucas, McKinney, Melissa, North Richland Hills, Ovilla, Pilot Point, Plano, Princeton, Prosper, Richardson, Roanoke, Saginaw, Southlake, Sunnyvale, The Colony, Trophy Club, University Park, Watauga, Westlake, and most of Denton, Dallas, Tarrant, and Collin county.

-----

## Services & Pricing

### Loose Photos — Shoebox

- Standard Shoebox: $109/box (loose photos — any box up to 14″×8″×5″, up to ~1,000 photos, archival-quality scans. Cardboard-backed, wrapped, or album-style photos require extra handling and are quoted individually.)
- Enhanced Shoebox: $149/box (everything in Standard plus AI color, contrast & brightness correction — both versions included)

### Photo Albums

- Small Album (up to 100 photos): $49 standard / $69 enhanced
- Standard Album (up to 200 photos): $69 standard / $89 enhanced
- Large Album (up to 400 photos, including magnetic and sticky-page albums): $109 standard / $129 enhanced

### VHS & Camcorder Tapes

Formats accepted: VHS, Hi8, 8mm, Digital8, MiniDV

- Standard Digitizing: $19.99/tape
- Digitizing + AI Enhancement: $29.99/tape

### Film Negative Digitizing

Single negatives and strips accepted, including 35mm and disposable camera negatives. Quoted individually — contact David with a photo of what you have.

### Photo Restoration

- Manual Restoration: $19.99/photo (hand-editing plus AI enhancement for torn, faded, or water-damaged photos; complex restorations quoted individually)

### Easy Street Add-Ons

Add to any digitizing order. David stays at drop-off, sets everything up, and ensures it's working before he leaves.

- TV Setup: $95 (photos formatted for TV slideshow)
- Computer Setup: $95 (files organized, walkthrough included)
- Digital Frame Setup: $229 (best photos hand-selected, loaded onto a 10″ digital frame, placed in the home — frame included, no WiFi or apps required)

### Project Minimum

$99 minimum per project. Photos, albums, and tapes can be combined to reach it.

-----

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Slide scanning is NOT offered.
- Every order includes local pickup and delivery, or drop-off at our Flower Mound location inside the GEICO office at 4630 Long Prairie Rd Ste 200. There is no shipping.
- Files are delivered on an engraved flash drive in a keepsake tin. A short-term download link is available for smaller projects.
- David has 25+ years of experience in insurance and IT.
- Digitize DFW is a licensed Texas LLC.
- Payment accepted: cash, Zelle, Venmo, credit card.
- Turnaround: most photo projects 1–2 weeks; tape orders of 1–5 tapes typically within one week.
- VHS tapes capture in real time (a 2-hour tape takes 2 hours).
